data_point: Open role for a Controller, Head of Finance or first finance hire
run_when: Job titles are available and one may be a finance role.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company has an open role for a Controller, Head of Finance, CFO or its first finance hire.
prompt.definition: A finance hire means the books are about to be formalised.
yes_when: An open finance leadership or first finance role
no_when: Open roles are listed and none are finance roles
watch_out_for: An accountant role at an accounting firm doesn't apply (that's an exclusion)

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

queries: "{company}" hiring controller OR "head of finance" OR "finance manager"
